dos.text: Let MozBreadcrumbGroup manage slot assignment and aria-current, update() calls setupBreadcrumbs() on every update, which always re-slots every moz-breadcrumb child by document order and stamps aria-current="page" onto the last one.

donts.text: Don't expect the final breadcrumb to stay a clickable link, once the group marks it aria-current="page", MozBreadcrumb's own render() drops the <a href> wrapper for any breadcrumb with ariaCurrent set and renders plain text instead.
